sentences.en: VICTOR: Right, well, for our presentation shall I start with the early life of Thor Heyerdahl?
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 好的，那么在我们的演讲中，我先从托尔·海尔达尔的早年生活讲起，可以吗？

sentences.en: OLIVIA: Sure
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Why don't you begin with describing the type of boy he was, especially his passion for collecting things
sentences.zh: 为什么不先描述一下他小时候是个怎样的男孩，尤其是他对收集物品的浓厚热情呢？

sentences.en: VICTOR: That's right, he had his own little museum
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 没错，他甚至建起了属于自己的小型博物馆。

sentences.en: And I think it's unusual for children to develop their own values and not join in their parents' hobbies; I'm thinking of how Heyerdahl wouldn't go hunting with his dad, for example
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，孩子能自主形成价值观、而不追随父母的兴趣爱好，这确实比较少见；比如，海尔达尔就拒绝跟父亲一起去打猎。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: Yeah, he preferred to learn about nature by listening to his mother read to him
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 是啊，他更喜欢通过听母亲为他朗读来了解自然。

sentences.en: And quite early on he knew he wanted to become an explorer when he grew up
sentences.zh: 而且很早就明确表示，长大后想成为一名探险家。

sentences.en: That came from his camping trips he went on in Norway think
sentences.zh: 这种志向源自他在挪威参加的露营活动，我想是这样。

sentences.en: VICTOR: No, it was climbing that he spent his time on as a young man
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 不对，他年轻时花大量时间从事的是登山运动。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: Oh, right After university he married a classmate and together, they decided to experience living on a small island, to find out how harsh weather conditions shaped people's lifestyles
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 哦，对了。大学毕业后，他与一位同班同学结婚，两人共同决定去一座小岛体验生活，以探究严酷的天气条件如何影响当地人的生活方式。

sentences.en: VICTOR: As part of their preparation before they left home, they learnt basic survival skills like building a shelter
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 出发前，他们在家做了充分准备，学习了搭建庇护所等基本生存技能。

sentences.en: I guess they needed that knowledge in order to live wild in a remote location with few inhabitants, cut off by the sea, which is what they were aiming to do
sentences.zh: 我想，他们需要掌握这些知识，才能在人烟稀少、被大海隔绝的偏远地区过上野外生活——而这正是他们此行的目标。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: An important part of your talk should be the radical theory Heyerdahl formed from examining mysterious ancient carvings that he happened to find on the island
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 你演讲中一个关键部分，应是他偶然在岛上发现神秘古代岩刻后，由此提出的激进理论。

sentences.en: I think you should finish with that
sentences.zh: 我觉得你应该以这部分内容收尾。

sentences.en: VICTOR: OK
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 好的。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: All right, Victor, so after your part I'll talk about Thor Heyerdahl's adult life, continuing from the theory he had about Polynesian migration
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 好吧，维克多，等你讲完之后，我来接着介绍托尔·海尔达尔成年后的生活，延续他关于波利尼西亚人迁徙的理论。

sentences.en: Up until that time of course, academics had believed that humans first migrated to the islands in Polynesia from Asia, in the west
sentences.zh: 当然，在那之前，学术界普遍认为人类最初是从西边的亚洲迁徙到波利尼西亚诸岛的。

sentences.en: VICTOR: Yes, they thought that travel from the east was impossible, because of the huge, empty stretch of ocean that lies between the islands and the nearest inhabited land
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 是的，他们认为自东向西航行根本不可能，因为岛屿与最近的有人居住陆地之间横亘着一片浩瀚无垠的海洋。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: Yes, but Heyerdahl spent ages studying the cloud movements, ocean currents and wind patterns to find if it was actually possible
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 没错，但海尔达尔花了大量时间研究云层移动、洋流和风向模式，以验证这种东向迁徙是否真的可行。

sentences.en: And another argument was that there was no tradition of large ship-building in the communities lying to the east of Polynesia
sentences.zh: 另一项论据指出：波利尼西亚以东各社群并无建造大型船舶的传统。

sentences.en: But Heyerdahl knew they made lots of coastal voyages in locally built canoes
sentences.zh: 但海尔达尔知道，他们常使用本地制造的独木舟进行沿海航行。

sentences.en: VICTOR: Yes, or sailing on rafts, as was shown by the long voyage that Heyerdahl t did next
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 没错，或者像他随后完成的那次漫长航行所展示的那样，乘坐筏子航行。

sentences.en: It was an incredibly risky journey to undertake - sometimes I wonder if he did that trip for private reasons, you know?
sentences.zh: 这是一次极其危险的旅程——有时我甚至怀疑，他进行这次航行是否出于个人原因，你知道的？

sentences.en: To show others that he could have spectacular adventures
sentences.zh: 比如向他人证明自己也能经历惊心动魄的冒险。

sentences.en: What do you think, Olivia?
sentences.zh: 你觉得呢，奥利维亚？

sentences.en: OLIVIA: Well, I think it was more a matter of simply trying out his idea, to see if migration from the east was possible
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 嗯，我认为他更多只是想亲自验证自己的设想，看看自东向西的迁徙是否真的可能。

sentences.en: VICTOR: Yes, that's probably it
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 是的，大概就是这样。

sentences.en: And the poor guy suffered a bit at that time because the war forced him to stop his work for some years
sentences.zh: 而这位可怜的先生当时还遭受了一些困苦，因为战争迫使他中断工作数年。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: Yes
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 是的。

sentences.en: When he got started again and planned his epic voyage, do you think it was important to him that he achieve it before anyone else did?
sentences.zh: 当他重新开始并筹划那次史诗般的航行时，你觉得在他心中，是否特别在意要抢在别人之前实现这一壮举？

sentences.en: VICTOR: Um, I haven't read anywhere that that was his motivation
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 呃，我从未在任何资料中读到过这是他的动机。

sentences.en: The most important factor seems to have been that he use only ancient techniques
sentences.zh: 似乎最重要的因素在于，他必须仅采用古代技术。

sentences.en: and local materials to build his raft
sentences.zh: 并使用本地材料来建造他的筏子。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: Yes
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 是的。

sentences.en: I wonder how fast it went
sentences.zh: 我想知道它的航速有多快。

sentences.en: VICTOR: Well, it took them 97 days from South America to the Pacific Islands
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 嗯，他们从南美洲抵达太平洋诸岛共耗时97天。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: Mm
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 嗯。

sentences.en: And after that, Heyerdahl went to Easter Island, didn't he?
sentences.zh: 之后，海尔达尔去了复活节岛，对吗？

sentences.en: We should mention the purpose of that trip
sentences.zh: 我们应当提及那次旅行的目的。

sentences.en: I think he sailed there in a boat made out of reeds
sentences.zh: 我想他是乘坐一艘芦苇制成的船航行到那里的。

sentences.en: VICTOR: No, that was later on in Egypt, Olivia
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 不，那是在埃及发生的后来的事，奥利维亚。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: Oh, yes, that's right
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 哦，是的，没错。

sentences.en: VICTOR: But what he wanted to do was talk to the local people about their old stone carvings and then make one himself to learn more about the process
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 但他真正想做的是与当地人交流，了解他们古老的石刻艺术，然后亲自制作一件石刻作品，以更深入地理解整个制作过程。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: I see
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 我明白了。

sentences.en: Well, what a great life
sentences.zh: 哇，真是精彩非凡的一生啊。

sentences.en: Even though many of his theories have been disproven, he certainly left a lasting impression on many disciplines, didn't he?
sentences.zh: 尽管他许多理论已被证伪，但他确实在多个学科领域留下了持久深远的影响，不是吗？

sentences.en: To my mind, he was the first person to establish what modern
sentences.zh: 在我看来，他是首位确立现代……

sentences.en: academics call practical archaeology
sentences.zh: 学者所称的‘实践考古学’的人。

sentences.en: I mean, that they try to recreate
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如今他们尝试重现……

sentences.en: something from the past today, like he did with his raft trip
sentences.zh: 过去的事物，就像他当年乘筏远航所做的那样。

sentences.en: It's unfortunate that his ideas about where Polynesians originated from have been completely discredited
sentences.zh: 遗憾的是，他关于波利尼西亚人起源地的观点已被彻底推翻。

sentences.en: VICTOR: Yes
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 是的。

sentences.en: Right, well, I'll prepare a PowerPoint slide at the end that acknowledges our sources
sentences.zh: 好的，那么我将在最后准备一张PowerPoint幻灯片，注明我们的资料来源。

sentences.en: I mainly used The Life and Work of Thor Heyerdahl by William Oliver. thought the research methods he used were very sound, although I must say I found the overall tone somewhat old-fashioned
sentences.zh: 我主要参考了威廉·奥利弗所著的《托尔·海尔达尔的生平与工作》。我认为他所采用的研究方法非常扎实，不过必须承认，我觉得全书整体文风略显陈旧。

sentences.en: I think they need to do a new, revised edition
sentences.zh: 我认为这本书有必要推出新版并加以修订。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: Yeah, I agree
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 是的，我同意。

sentences.en: What about the subject matter - found it really challenging!
sentences.zh: 至于主题内容——我觉得真的很有挑战性！

sentences.en: VICTOR: Well, it's a complex issue
sentences.zh: VICTOR: 嗯，这是一个复杂的问题。

sentences.en: OLIVIA: thought the book had lots of good points
sentences.zh: OLIVIA: 我觉得这本书提出了许多很有价值的观点。

sentences.en: What did you think of
sentences.zh: 你觉得……
